notes:
WI-07 (UC-010) — IGeoService orchestration layer (cache→client→degradation) replacing IGeoProvider + FakeGeoProvider.

== WHAT WAS DELIVERED ==

1. IGeoService (Infrastructure/Geo/IGeoService.cs):
   - SuggestAsync(fleetId, q, near?, ct) -> GeoCacheResult<IReadOnlyList<MapySuggestResult>>
   - GeocodeAsync(fleetId, q, ct) -> GeoCacheResult<MapyGeocodeResult>
   - ReverseAsync(fleetId, lat, lng, ct) -> GeoCacheResult<MapyRgeocodeResult>
   - RouteAsync(fleetId, fromLat, fromLng, toLat, toLng, ct) -> GeoRouteServiceResult
   - QuickPlaceAsync(fleetId, placeKey, ct) -> GeoCacheResult<IReadOnlyList<MapySuggestResult>>

2. GeoService (Infrastructure/Geo/GeoService.cs): internal sealed, SCOPED.
   - Takes (IMapyClient, GeoCache) — no GeoUsageRecorder injection (accounting is inside GeoCache).
   - SuggestAsync special case: when fleetId == Guid.Empty (fleetless customer), bypasses GeoCache entirely and calls mapyClient directly. geo_cache and geo_usage have FK constraints to fleets; Guid.Empty has no fleet row and would cause EF InvalidOperationException. Suggest results are not tenant-sensitive so this bypass is safe.
   - RouteAsync special case: when GeoCache returns Unavailable, computes haversine x 1.3 estimate via HaversineDistance.Meters + GeoEstimateFallback.RoadDistanceMeters/DurationSeconds and returns GeoRouteServiceResult{Success(degraded), WasHit=false, IsEstimate=true}.
   - QuickPlaceAsync: factory always returns Unavailable immediately (never calls IMapyClient) -> GeoCache records no usage on Unavailable.

3. GeoRouteServiceResult (Infrastructure/Geo/GeoRouteServiceResult.cs):
   - record(GeoResult<MapyRouteResultData> Result, bool WasHit, bool IsEstimate).
   - IsEstimate=true signals degraded haversine fallback — callers decide surface (RouteEndpoint 502, WI-10 QuoteEndpoint orientacni odhad).

4. GeoFeatureConfiguration: removed photon/osrm HttpClients + IGeoProvider singleton; added services.AddScoped<IGeoService, GeoService>().

5. Endpoint repoints:
   - SuggestEndpoint: IGeoProvider -> IGeoService. Uses fleetId = currentTenant.FleetId ?? Guid.Empty (customers may have no fleet_id claim; GeoService handles Guid.Empty by bypassing cache). On Unavailable -> 200 empty list.
   - RouteEndpoint: IGeoProvider -> IGeoService. Guards currentTenant.FleetId -> 400 if null. On IsEstimate=true -> 502 (WI-09 convention).
   - QuoteEndpoint: IGeoProvider -> IGeoService. Same pattern. IsEstimate -> 502 (WI-10 fallback not yet implemented).

6. FakeGeoService replaces FakeGeoProvider everywhere:
   - Implements IGeoService; bypasses GeoCache entirely.
   - SuggestResult (IReadOnlyList<MapySuggestResult>), SuggestShouldReturnUnavailable, RouteResult (MapyRouteResultData?), RouteShouldReturnUnavailable.
   - Reset() discipline: must be called first in every test helper (shared singleton across test collection).
   - TaxiApiFactory.FakeGeo is now FakeGeoService, registered as both FakeGeoService singleton and IGeoService.

7. Deleted orphaned types: IGeoProvider, PhotonOsrmGeoProvider (old Photon/OSRM impl), GeoSuggestItem, GeoRouteResult, FakeGeoProvider.

== TDD TESTS (4 new in GeoServiceTests.cs) ==

1. Route_CacheHit_NoClientCallNoCredit: warms cache via real GeoCache.GetOrAddAsync (usage=1), then calls GeoService.RouteAsync with CountingMapyClient — asserts 0 client calls and usage still=1.
2. Route_ClientUnavailable_ReturnsHaversineEstimateFlaggedWider: FakeMapyClient returns Unavailable; asserts result.IsEstimate=true, result.Result is Success with distanceMeters = round(haversine*1.3), no geo_usage row created.
3. QuickPlace_NeverCallsClientOrIncrementsUsage: QuickPlaceAsync on cache miss; asserts 0 client calls, no geo_usage row.
4. Suggest_NoFleetId_BypassesCacheAndUsage: fleetId=Guid.Empty, verifies no EF FK violation (no geo_usage row written), mapyClient result returned directly.

All tests use manually constructed GeoService (not from TaxiApiFactory DI) over a real scoped GeoCache + real GeoUsageRecorder against Testcontainers DB — proving actual accounting behavior.

== ACCOUNTING INVARIANT (verified end-to-end) ==

GeoCache.GetOrAddAsync is the SINGLE usage-recording site. GeoService does NOT inject or call GeoUsageRecorder. Route_CacheHit_NoClientCallNoCredit confirms usage is not double-counted.

== CRITICAL TRAP: GeoService fleetless-suggest bypass ==

geo_cache.fleet_id and geo_usage.fleet_id both have FK constraints to the fleets table. Calling GeoCache.GetOrAddAsync with Guid.Empty causes EF to throw InvalidOperationException (not a Postgres FK error — EF detects the unknown FK before SaveChanges). GeoService.SuggestAsync guards: when fleetId == Guid.Empty, call mapyClient directly, skip cache + usage. Appended to CLAUDE.md.

== TRAPS FOR FUTURE WIs ==

- FakeGeoService returns MapyRouteResultData (not the old GeoRouteResult). Any existing test that set fake.RouteResult = new GeoRouteResult(...) must use new MapyRouteResultData(distanceMeters, durationSeconds, []) instead.
- QuickPlaceAsync factory never calls IMapyClient — it returns Unavailable immediately. GeoCache therefore writes no L2 row and records no usage. A populated QuickPlace entry must be seeded directly into geo_cache by the caller (WI-08 or fleet onboarding).
- SuggestEndpoint uses fleetId=Guid.Empty for customers (no fleet_id claim). GeoService.SuggestAsync handles this by bypassing the cache+usage entirely (direct mapyClient call).
- RouteEndpoint and QuoteEndpoint both guard currentTenant.FleetId->400; suggest does NOT guard (fleetless customers are allowed).
- GeoService is registered SCOPED (depends on scoped GeoCache). The TaxiApiFactory overrides IGeoService with FakeGeoService (singleton) — this works because the override replaces the scoped registration entirely.
